scriptLines:
query: ' SELECT a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk, pk.paciente_key, dk.departamento_key,
  dxk.diagnostico_key, fi.fecha_key AS fecha_ingreso_key, fa.fecha_key AS fecha_alta_key,
  a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id,
  CASE WHEN a.discharge_date IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(DAY,a.admission_date,a.discharge_date) END AS dias_estancia,
  1 AS conteo_admisiones
FROM silver.admissions a
JOIN silver.diagnoses dx ON dx.admission_id = a.admission_id
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_paciente pk ON pk.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_departamento dk ON dk.nombre_departamento = a.department
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico dxk ON dxk.codigo_icd = dx.icd_code
  AND dxk.nivel_severidad = ISNULL(dx.severity,'No Determinada')
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_fecha fi ON fi.fecha_key = CONVERT(INT, FORMAT(a.admission_date,'yyyyMMdd'))
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_fecha fa ON fa.fecha_key = CONVERT(INT, FORMAT(a.discharge_date,'yyyyMMdd'))',
